G-Dragon has turned heads with another unconventional fashion choice, this time hiding nearly his entire face behind a black knit balaclava — and raising the question of whether the unusual look could become his next trend.
A social media account run by the K-pop star's staff shared a series of photos Friday without a caption, showing G-Dragon in an outfit that put his signature experimental style on full display.
In the photos, the BIGBANG member wears a black knit balaclava covering most of his face, paired with a blue-toned jacket, wide-leg pants and a small red bag.
The face-concealing headwear is not an easy fashion item to pull off, but G-Dragon incorporates it naturally into the outfit, adding yet another unconventional accessory to his long list of headline-making looks.
G-Dragon has long been regarded as one of K-pop's most influential fashion figures, with his clothing, accessories and styling choices frequently drawing attention well beyond the stage.
That track record is now putting the spotlight on his latest choice: whether the balaclava will remain one of G-Dragon's more eccentric looks or find its way into the fashion mainstream.
Meanwhile, G-Dragon is currently meeting fans through BIGBANG's world tour. The group is set to continue its Asian leg from November, with stops including Bangkok, Hong Kong, Japan and Malaysia.
